EC1: - contraindications for tDCS (e.g., cardiac pacemaker, history of seizures, [OR] implanted metal inside the head);
EC2: - more than one clinically apparent stroke [AND] with aphasic symptoms;
EC3: - other severe neurological diseases (e.g., epilepsy, [OR] brain tumor, [AND] and subdural hematoma);
EC4: - history of severe alcohol [OR] or drug abuse;
EC6: - current psychosis [OR] or other relevant psychiatric condition;
EC7: - very severe apraxia of speech, as revealed by Hierarchical Word Lists;
EC8: - severe non-verbal cognitive deficits, as indicated by the Corsi Block-Tapping Task;
EC10: - severely impaired vision [OR] or hearing that prevents patients from engaging in intensive SLT;
EC11: - changes in centrally active drugs within 2 weeks prior to study inclusion.
